name: Pencil
summary: Pencil: AI ad creative generation and testing for performance marketing.
description: Pencil produces and iterates ad variants (copy, visuals, video) with predictive scoring for Meta, Google, and TikTok campaigns.

Brand kit and asset guardrails for consistency.
Export to ad platforms and creative testing workflows.
